correctness.rationale: The parameter-to-chord identity yields exact spherical cap union with triple intersection impossible below the largest chord. Each pair intersection is integrated from the normalized joint spherical density. Its arctangent formula follows by matching a derivative and an endpoint. Rescaling a vanishing pair overlap yields the 3/2 coefficient and O(5/2) remainder; the normalized Dirichlet(1/2,1/2,1/2) density on a shrinking planar simplex proves the endpoint quadratic coefficient and O(cube) remainder for all positive box half-lengths. A standalone standard-library numeric checker completed and passed seeded tests, without replacing proof. Normals and equality boundaries are handled explicitly.

originality.rationale: Targeted searches and full inspection of three closely related published results show none has the centered Haar one-dimensional box CDF, its 3D cap-pair onset classification and terminal coefficient; full Coleman (1969) text treats different sampling laws, and Guédon et al. derives bounds rather than this exact distribution.
